failureStrings: Unlock this item in Collections to purchase
Requires all previous rewards to be claimed
You already have an Exotic Cipher.

interactions.flavorLineOne: Xûr nods gently at you in acknowledgment of your help. "The ones I serve are in motion. Nothing can stop that. In time, they will call upon you as Weapon. Your purpose will superimpose itself on your will. The eight I serve will harness your violence for their needs. But until then, you remain your own. When next we meet, I will serve you more than just lunch." He turns his gaze skyward. He is suddenly consumed in reverie, and his business with you appears concluded.
Xûr doesn't have much to call his own, but he'll always have your gift. Until he eats them. If he does eat.

"The Nine watch you, Guardian. I do not know why, because nobody can know the Nine."

Xûr spasms in an unpredictable cadence. A tentacle wafts out from his hood to float near you. Your skin hears its aroma.

By the time you process the sensation, an object has appeared in Xûr's hand.

"I hand you this gift, but I am nothing, so know that it is of and from the Nine. Your acceptance is arbitrary."
Purchasing items from Xûr with Strange Coins grants reputation.
